_read_me: Demonstration clients. Secrets are stored as SHA-256 hashes and the plain ones are in the README on purpose: this is a demonstration of a permission boundary, and a boundary you cannot stand on both sides of is an assertion rather than a demonstration. Generate a hash with: node tools/hash-secret.mjs
